concrete_capability_transition: Default brownie run objective execution moves from runtime provider-runner admission toward a runtime-owned development-capable journey: omitted mode is resolved by the Rust runtime to an existing development-capable Mode Pack, and ordinary development objectives can surface bounded objective proposal routes without CLI-owned mode policy.

strategic_capability_mapping.relationship: Makes the official primary CLI objective path enter the Rust runtime's development-capable controlled workspace proposal flow without the CLI selecting implementer, orchestrator, or permission policy.
Keeps mode resolution and workspace write authority inside the Rust runtime and existing AgentModes policy instead of moving that decision into the CLI.
Connects ordinary development objectives to the existing controlled replace_file proposal route while preserving explicit apply authorization and preflight boundaries.

answers.strategic_capabilities: Advances headless_autonomous_development, runtime-enforced permissions, and controlled workspace tools.
answers.new_capability: An omitted-mode default development journey can now resolve to a development-capable runtime mode and produce one bounded valid pending replace_file proposal candidate for explicit authorization.
answers.why_existing_functionality_is_insufficie: Previous CLI evidence could complete a no-files-changed provider-runner path; that did not prove the primary command can enter Brownie's controlled workspace mutation loop.
answers.product_gap_if_skipped: CLI Product Completion would still be able to pass while the primary brownie run command avoids the core read, propose, apply, verify, and complete development capability.
answers.non_duplicative: CLI-C1 is not another invocation, resume, output, install, recovery, or pointer phase. It changes the runtime behavior behind default run admission and objective proposal routing.
answers.no_new_rpc: Yes. The current implementation uses existing headless.run.drive, headless.continue_once, proposal, apply, verification, and completion route concepts.
answers.no_new_summary: Yes. No report, readiness, digest, history, verdict, or inspection-only surface is added.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: Runtime behavior changes: omitted journey mode now resolves to implementer, and default journeys without objective_context can expose bounded objective proposal candidate evidence.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: The primary CLI command can enter a runtime-selected development route while remaining replay-safe through deterministic journey/task/run fingerprints.
answers.milestone_progress: Partially closes cli-primary-run-development-path; full closure still requires installed CLI/runtime evidence through apply, verification, objective completion acceptance, and finalization.

CLI output and JSON remain bounded and sanitized.
CLI-C1 closes only cli-primary-run-development-path; cli-session-scoped-completion and cli-real-timeout-resume-evidence remain open.
